messages:
Alice: Quick kickoff — I want to run a 3-part micro-lab series for community/devs: 1) local dev loop + toy ref app, 2) short benchmark narrative comparing batching/quantization impacts, 3) a live 45-min webinar that walks through the repo and onboarding flow. Goal: drive signups and inbound for Dedicated trials.
Sam: love it. target audience = devs who tried hosted APIs but want predictable perf + lower cost?
Alice: exactly. two personas: 'explorer dev' (PLG, fast wins) and 'platform engineer' (SRE/infra, cares about costs & SLAs).
Priya: recommend short blog + 3x tutorial vids (5–7m each) + a single downloadable repo with examples and a simple dashboard. Also a gated webinar with an inbound routing flow.
Maya: for gating — we should route Qualified leads to AE funnel; non-qualified get nurturing sequence + dev sandbox invite. I'll map the routing.
Jorge: I'll design a compact hero image and 3 screenshots showing local loop -> hosted deploy -> cost/latency dashboard. Need copy direction.
Sam: proposed repo name: `redwood-micro-labs/local-inference-loop`. CLI quickstart snippet: ```bash
# clone
git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-micro-labs.git
cd local-inference-loop
# start dev server (docker)
make dev
# run example
python examples/chat_refapp.py --model=redwood-small
```
Priya: nice. For the benchmark narrative: short setup, baseline (no batching/no-quant), then two optimizations: batching (x tokens/sec), int8 quant (y% cost reduction). Keep numbers concrete but friendly.
Alice: timeline suggestion: Week 1: tutorial drafts + repo skeleton. Week 2: recordings + blog draft + graphics. Week 3: webinar rehearsals + landing page + leadflow. Launch end of Week 3.
Maya: I'll draft the leadflow doc. routing rules: if company size > 50 && activity > 2 demos -> AE. Else if company uses on-prem -> AE. Else nurture. Capture utm + product usage events.
Sam: integration checklist for repo: example prompts, small dataset for eval, minimal inference config with batching toggles, example metrics export -> prometheus/console.
Jorge: one ask on assets — produce 16:9 webinar hero, 1:1 social, and a 1200x400 blog hero. I'll wireframes by Friday.
Priya: copy outline for blog: 1) motivation, 2) what you'll build, 3) quickstart, 4) benchmark highlights, 5) how to run on Redwood (hosted/dedicated/private), 6) next steps + webinar CTA.
Alice: tagging folks: @sam for repo owner, @priya for content lead, @jorge for visuals, @maya for lead routing.
Sam: I'll create repo skeleton today and open PR with README and examples. PR link when ready.
deploy-bot: Reminder: staging site deploy scheduled for 1839050000 (UTC). :rocket:
Priya: webinar format: 12–15m demo, 20m guided walkthrough + Q&A. Have one prepped benchmark slide and one live run of the quickstart.
Maya: capture registration fields: name, email, company, company size, cloud/on-prem checkbox, primary use case. Add hidden utm fields.
Alice: can someone draft 3 short test prompts we can use across tutorials/benchmark so numbers are comparable? e.g., chat summary (200 tokens), instruction-following (400 tokens), long-context retrieval (1024 tokens).
Sam: I'll add test prompts to `bench/prompts.md`. Also will add a small script to run the micro-bench locally and collect latency/cost estimates.
Jorge: will mock up the landing page visuals with placeholders for numbers — we'll swap real stats after we run the bench.
Priya: social plan: 3 teaser posts (launch, mini-bench highlight, webinar reminder) + 1 tutorial thread on X. Need short copy hooks.
Alice: blockers?
Sam: Need access to a small GPU instance for quant tests — will request with infra.
Maya: need the registration + routing JSON fields from web team by Monday.
Alice: ok. next sync Friday 11am PT. If any big blockers ping here. :thumbsup:
Priya: will create the doc & tracker: https://docs.google.com/document/d/placeholder-microlabs (will update with PRs and assets).
Sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-micro-labs/pull/5 (skeleton + prompts).
Jorge: wireframes uploaded to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder/microlabs-visuals
Maya: working on leadflow draft, will post JSON routing rules in the doc.
Alice: perfect. let's keep updates short in this thread. thanks everyone. :sparkles:
